decision_roles.name: Initiator
decision_roles.decision_need: Is the problem important enough to investigate?

decision_roles.name: Domain evaluator
decision_roles.decision_need: Does the product fit the operational problem?

decision_roles.name: Technical validator
decision_roles.decision_need: Can it integrate, operate and scale within constraints?

decision_roles.name: Security and compliance reviewer
decision_roles.decision_need: Are data, AI, permission and audit risks controlled?

decision_roles.name: Economic buyer
decision_roles.decision_need: Is value credible relative to cost and risk?

decision_roles.name: Final approver
decision_roles.decision_need: Is there sufficient evidence and accountable ownership to proceed?

decision_roles.name: Future user or administrator
decision_roles.decision_need: Can it be adopted and operated safely?

candidate_flow.website_responsibility: distinguish aTops and SPACEMON without unsupported claims
route to approved technical material, demo or inquiry
support internal sharing and multi-role review
capture qualified context and confirm accountable follow-up

exceptions.recovery: problem-led comparison and neutral inquiry route
show evidence status and request approved follow-up rather than claim
provide role-neutral overview then progressive disclosure
preserve input locally where safe, explain error and offer approved alternate channel
